extensionName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store.

extensionDescription.message: Switch between multiple accounts on any site — each tab gets its own isolated session.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store.

commandExecuteActionDescription.description: Keyboard shortcut description for the default browser action command.

commandSessionNextDescription.message: Switch to next session for this tab
commandSessionNextDescription.description: Keyboard shortcut description for the session-next command.

commandSessionPrevDescription.message: Switch to previous session for this tab
commandSessionPrevDescription.description: Keyboard shortcut description for the session-prev command.

popupBrandSub.description: Subtitle under the brand name in the popup header.

themeToggleLabel.description: Title/aria-label for the popup quick theme toggle button.

openOptionsLabel.description: Title/aria-label for the popup button that opens the Options page.

heroActiveLabel.description: Label above the active session name in the popup hero.

heroDefaultName.description: Name shown in the hero when no profile is active for the tab.

heroNoSessionMeta.description: Meta line shown under the hero name when no profile is active.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the popup profile search input.

searchAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the popup profile search input.

createPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the new-profile name input.

createButton.description: Button label to create a new profile.

listHeadProfiles.description: Header label above the profile list.

resetToDefault.description: Button label to switch the current tab back to the default (unscoped) session.

switchToDefaultConfirm.description: Inline confirmation prompt shown before resetting to the default session.

cancelButton.description: Generic cancel button label used in inline confirmations.

resetButton.description: Confirm button label for the reset-to-default action.

cannotIsolatePage.description: Message shown when the popup is opened on a page that cannot be session-isolated (e.g. chrome:// pages).

generatedSessionName.description: Default name assigned to a new profile when the user leaves the name field empty. Generated once at creation time and stored unchanged thereafter — never re-localized on later locale changes.

duplicatedSessionName.description: Name assigned to a duplicated profile. Generated once at duplication time from the source profile's stored name and then kept unchanged — never re-localized on later locale changes.

emptyNoProfilesTitle.description: Empty-state title shown when no profiles exist.

emptyNoProfilesSub.message: Create one above to start isolating accounts.
emptyNoProfilesSub.description: Empty-state subtitle shown when no profiles exist.

emptyNoMatchesTitle.description: Empty-state title shown when a search query matches no profiles.

emptyNoMatchesSub.description: Empty-state subtitle shown when a search query matches no profiles.

duplicateProfileTitle.description: Title tooltip for the duplicate-profile button on a profile card.

duplicateProfileAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the duplicate-profile button, naming the specific profile.

renameTitle.description: Title tooltip for the rename button on a profile card.

renameAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the rename button, naming the specific profile.

deleteTitle.description: Title tooltip for the delete button on a profile card.

deleteAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the delete button, naming the specific profile.

cancelDeleteTitle.description: Title tooltip for the cancel button in the inline delete-confirmation UI.

confirmDeleteTitle.description: Title tooltip for the confirm button in the inline delete-confirmation UI.

activeStatusPill.description: Small status pill shown on the currently active profile card.

heroLiveLabel.description: Status word shown next to the active session name in the popup hero.

openInNewTab.description: Menu item to open the current page in the selected profile via a new tab.

changeColorTitle.description: Title tooltip for the color dot that opens the color picker.

changeColorAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the color dot that opens the color picker.

pickColorAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the color picker popover.

sessionColorLabel.description: Heading text inside the color picker popover.

hueSwatchTitle.description: Title tooltip for a preset color swatch in the color picker, naming its numeric hue value.

customHueTitle.description: Title tooltip for the custom-hue swatch button in the color picker.

customHueAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the custom-hue swatch button in the color picker.

customLabel.description: Label for the custom-hue slider row in the color picker.

customHueValueAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the custom-hue range slider.

optionsSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the title in the Options page header.

extensionVersionAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the version chip in the Options page header.

tabSettings.description: Options page tab label for the settings panel.

tabAbout.description: Options page tab label for the about panel.

appearanceSectionTitle.description: Options page section heading for theme settings.

themeSettingLabel.description: Options page label for the theme setting row.

themeSettingDesc.message: Override the OS color scheme preference
themeSettingDesc.description: Options page description for the theme setting row.

themeGroupAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the group of theme choice buttons.

autoInheritLabel.message: Auto-open linked tabs in the same profile
autoInheritLabel.description: Options page label for the auto-inherit-profile setting row.

autoInheritDesc.message: When enabled, tabs opened from a link (new-tab links, Ctrl-click, middle-click) on an isolated profile stay in that profile instead of using Chrome's default cookies.
autoInheritDesc.description: Options page description for the auto-inherit-profile setting row.

groupTabsByProfileLabel.message: Group tabs by profile in the tab strip
groupTabsByProfileLabel.description: Options page label for the tab-grouping-by-profile setting row.

groupTabsByProfileDesc.message: Puts each profile's tabs into a colored tab group. Chrome will ask permission to manage tab groups. This reorders your tabs, and group colors are limited to Chrome's 9 preset colors, so two profile colors may look the same.
groupTabsByProfileDesc.description: Options page description for the tab-grouping-by-profile setting row.

groupTabsPermissionDeniedNotice.message: Permission declined. Tab grouping stays off.
groupTabsPermissionDeniedNotice.description: Options page notice shown when the user declines the tabGroups permission request.

aboutTagline.message: A free, open-source Chrome extension for per-tab session isolation. Stay logged into multiple accounts on the same site, simultaneously.
aboutTagline.description: Tagline shown in the Options page About panel.

supportSectionTitle.description: Options page About-panel section heading for the support/donation section.

supportDesc.message: SessionShift is free and open-source. If it saves you time, consider a small tip — it keeps the project alive and ad-free.
supportDesc.description: Options page About-panel description for the support/donation section.

supportCta.description: Call-to-action link text for the Ko-fi donation link.

linksSectionTitle.description: Options page About-panel section heading for external links.

githubLink.description: Link text for the GitHub repository link.

chromeWebStoreLink.description: Link text for the Chrome Web Store listing link.

contextMenuParentTitle.description: Parent title of the right-click context menu group. Extension-owned: created at runtime via chrome.contextMenus, so it follows the manual in-extension locale override, not only Chrome's UI locale.

languageSettingLabel.description: Options page label for the language preference picker.

languageSettingDesc.message: Applies to this popup, Options, and context menus. Chrome's own keyboard shortcuts, extension name, and description always follow your browser's language.
languageSettingDesc.description: Options page description clarifying the manual language override's scope versus Chrome-owned surfaces.

languageOptionSystem.description: Language picker option that delegates to Chrome's own UI locale instead of a pinned locale.

favoritesSectionTitle.description: Header above the saved-favorites list in the popup.

saveFavoriteTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup hero star when the current page is not yet saved.

saveFavoriteAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the popup hero star button. Its pressed state conveys whether the page is already saved.

savedFavoriteTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup hero star when the current page is already saved as a favorite.

saveFavoriteDefaultDisabledTitle.message: Switch this tab to a profile first to save it as a favorite.
saveFavoriteDefaultDisabledTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled star when the tab is still on the default profile, where a favorite would switch nothing.

saveFavoriteUnavailableTitle.message: This page cannot be saved as a favorite.
saveFavoriteUnavailableTitle.description: Tooltip on the disabled star for pages that are not http(s), such as chrome:// or the new-tab page.

launchFavoriteAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for a favorite row in the popup, naming the specific favorite.

removeFavoriteTitle.description: Tooltip on the per-row remove button in the popup favorites list.

removeFavoriteAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the per-row remove button, naming the specific favorite.

favoriteMissingProfile.description: Shown on a favorite whose bound profile has been deleted. The favorite cannot be launched until it is re-assigned.

favoritesLimitReached.message: Favorite limit reached — remove one to save another.
favoritesLimitReached.description: Shown when the maximum number of stored favorites has been reached.

tabFavorites.description: Options page tab label for the favorites manager panel.

favoritesSectionDesc.message: Saved pages that open in a chosen profile. Save one with the star in the popup; rename, re-point or reorder it here.
favoritesSectionDesc.description: Intro paragraph at the top of the Options favorites panel.

favoriteLabelColumn.description: Accessible name for the editable favorite-name field in Options.

favoriteUrlColumn.description: Accessible name for the editable favorite-address field in Options.

favoriteProfileColumn.description: Accessible name for the profile selector that decides which profile a favorite opens in.

favoriteMoveUpAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the reorder-up button, naming the specific favorite.

favoriteMoveDownAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the reorder-down button, naming the specific favorite.

favoriteDeleteAriaLabel.description: Aria-label for the delete button in the Options favorites list, naming the specific favorite.

favoritesEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state in the Options favorites panel.

favoritesEmptySub.message: Open a page in a profile, then click the star in the SessionShift popup to save it here.
favoritesEmptySub.description: Body of the empty state in the Options favorites panel, pointing the user at the popup star.

favoriteInvalidUrl.message: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
favoriteInvalidUrl.description: Inline error shown when an edited favorite address is rejected. The field reverts to its previous value.

favoritesReorderedAnnouncement.description: Screen-reader announcement after a favorite is moved up or down.

favoriteRemovedAnnouncement.description: Screen-reader announcement after a favorite is deleted, naming it.
